answers.q1: uv (lockfile uv.lock, Python 3.11 per .python-version). Install from the repo root with: uv sync --locked --extra all. This is what the pre-commit CI job runs. The test CI job runs: uv sync --locked --no-dev --group tests --extra all. The plain `uv sync` in AGENTS.md also works but doesn't match CI. Don't use pip.
answers.q2: uv run bash scripts/run-tests.sh. This runs `pytest -n auto --dist loadgroup tests scripts/tests/` with PYTHONPATH=./docs_src. CI uses `uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh`, which is the same run plus coverage. A bare `uv run pytest` skips the PYTHONPATH setting, xdist and scripts/tests.
answers.q4: CI runs pre-commit hooks through prek: uv run prek run --from-ref origin/<base-branch> --to-ref HEAD --show-diff-on-failure. To check the whole repo, run those hooks directly or use the style script: uv run bash scripts/check-style.sh. The script runs: mypy fastapi; ty check; ruff check fastapi tests docs_src scripts; ruff format fastapi tests --check. The pre-commit hooks also run typos, zizmor and the file-hygiene checks. Don't run scripts/format.sh to check, because it modifies files with --fix.
answers.q5: uv.lock (generated lockfile). README.md is generated from docs/en/docs/index.md by `scripts/docs.py generate-readme`, so edit index.md instead. The sponsor banner partial docs/en/overrides/partials/banner-sponsors.html is generated from docs/en/data/sponsors.yml by `scripts/docs.py render-banner-sponsors`. Non-English translations under docs/<lang>/ (other than docs/en) are managed by the translation tooling, and the ensure-non-translated hook rejects manual edits to them. The docs language list is updated by `scripts/docs.py update-languages`. No vendored directories were found.
